title: 第一篇 入世 第五章 学堂识字学不够 教书先生爱念咒第一篇 入世 第六章 溪边林里掏树窟 吸收晶石得奇书
content_zh:
转眼又过了半月有余，玉壶宗的风波也已经被淡忘在忙碌的季节。
村子里的人们又开始了新一年的耕作打猎生活，那乡野间的忙碌身影为这个深山中的村庄增添了一道生机，孩童们也在三五成群的玩耍，只是少了那位讲故事的少年，村口的大石处便少了那道壮观的风景，变得萧索了许多。
村外的溪水汩汩的流淌，溪边一个胖乎乎的孩童盘坐在一块石头上，手里握着一卷书籍，怔怔的望着湖面发呆，颇有些落寞的感觉。
突然“扑通”一声，他的面前溅起了水花，乌凡的表情马上变得喜悦起来，不由得回头高呼到：“吴大哥！”
望着身后空荡荡的地面，才回想起吴昊已经走了许久，那打破平静的却不是吴昊扔出的石子，而是一只受惊的蛙。
他感觉被捉弄了一般，放下那卷书，拾起周围的石子对那只蛙狂轰滥炸，见其仓皇逃窜，才觉得解气，便又拾起了书本，翻阅起来。
不知不觉中，时间就一天天的过去了，书本上的生字在娘亲的标注下，也变得越来越少，渐渐的乌凡已经能将这本书上的字全部认全。
一日午后，乌凡吃过饭便又去溪边读书锻炼了，仿佛听着那溪水的声音还有那溪边的回忆才能给自己带来真正的平静。
此时乌凡家中的房门被敲响，乌凡的娘亲一开门，发觉是村长先生，便邀请他进屋一坐。村长四下望了望，便点了点头，跟随她进了屋子，“村长先生，你先坐，我去给你倒杯茶。”
村长也没有要坐的意思，行了个礼说道：“不麻烦姑娘了，我来说几句话就走了。”
“怎么能是麻烦，这么些年，还是承蒙的村长的照顾了。”
村长听闻，便是赶紧摆了摆手，“照顾倒是谈不上，只是受人所托，尽些力所能及的事情罢了。”仿佛又想起了什么，便慌忙抬手握了握拳头，“对了姑娘，我这次来是有事来通知你的。”
乌凡娘亲闻言眉头一皱，刚要说什么，便被打断了。
“哈哈，姑娘莫急，我这次来是为了乌凡来的，虽然乌凡年龄还小，但是悟性却是极高，我前些天和教书先生商量过，过几天学堂要开学了，正好将他送入学堂学习，也好在下次玉壶宗来招弟子的时候做些准备嘛。”
乌凡娘亲闻言，点了点头，便应允了。
“那还是多谢村长了。”
“哪里哪里，应该的，应该的，那既然这样，到时候我再来叨扰一下，那我先走了。”
说完村长便走出了门。
“且慢，承蒙你多年的帮助，这是一点谢礼，还请村长不要嫌弃。”
说着乌凡娘亲手中便出现了一颗药丸，“这是锻筋丹，虽然不是很贵重，但却也能强筋壮骨，增强人的体质。”

村长闻言，身体抑制不住的颤抖，双手接住丹药，捧在手心里，赶紧鞠了一躬，“谢谢，谢谢姑娘。”
乌凡娘亲只是微微一笑，什么也没说，便转身进了屋子。村长于是面带喜色，双手捧着丹药匆匆忙忙的向家中赶去。
乌凡娘亲的眼中带着一丝复杂的感情，倚在窗棂边望着天边怔怔的出着神，蓦然低下头，解开了腰间绛紫色的香囊。
那香囊约有成人半拳大小，上面缝着复杂的花纹，开口处却也缝的死死的，里面不知装的是什么香料，总能散发出一股淡淡的香气。
而仔细去闻时却又感觉不到，似有似无。
她望着香囊，不禁喃喃自语，“躲到哪里都藏不住，原来你真的在乎我。”伴随着一声叹息，一滴玉珠滴落在地上，碎成了万千往事，化为了云烟。
转眼就到了学堂开学的日子，一早乌凡就兴致勃勃的搓着小手。
毕竟一直听着学堂里的声音，却碍于年纪迟迟不能接触，终于今天能进去学堂了，激动的小脸红彤彤的。
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, more than half a month has passed, and the turmoil in the Yuhu Sect has been forgotten in the busy season.
People in the village have started a new year of farming and hunting. The busy figures in the countryside have added vitality to the village in the mountains. Children are also playing in groups. However, without the boy telling the story, the spectacular scenery at the big rock at the entrance of the village has become much more desolate.
The stream outside the village was flowing gurglingly. A chubby child was sitting cross-legged on a stone by the stream, holding a book in his hand and staring at the lake in a daze, feeling quite lonely.
Suddenly there was a "plop", and water splashed in front of him. Wu Fan's expression immediately became joyful, and he couldn't help but turn around and shout: "Brother Wu!"
Looking at the empty ground behind him, he recalled that Wu Hao had been gone for a long time. What broke the peace was not the stone thrown by Wu Hao, but a frightened frog.
He felt as if he had been teased, so he put down the book, picked up the surrounding stones and bombarded the frog wildly. When he saw it running away in a hurry, he felt relieved, so he picked up the book again and started reading.
Unconsciously, time passed day by day, and the new words in the book became less and less under the annotations of his mother. Gradually, Wu Fan was able to recognize all the words in the book.
One afternoon, after eating, Wu Fan went to read and exercise by the stream again. It seemed that listening to the sound of the stream and the memories by the stream could bring him real peace.
At this time, there was a knock on the door of Wu Fan's house. Wu Fan's mother opened the door and found that it was the village chief, so she invited him to come in and sit. The village chief looked around, nodded, and followed her into the house, "Mr. Village Chief, you sit down first, and I'll get you a cup of tea."
The village chief had no intention of sitting down. He bowed and said, "Don't bother me, girl. I'll say a few words and then leave."
"How can it be trouble? After all these years, I have been taken care of by the village chief."
When the village chief heard this, he quickly waved his hand, "I can't even talk about taking care of you. I'm just doing what I can to do what I can when I'm entrusted by others." As if he remembered something again, he hurriedly raised his hand and clenched his fist, "By the way, girl, I came here to inform you of something."
Mother Wu Fan frowned when she heard this. She was about to say something when she was interrupted.
"Haha, don't worry, girl. I'm here this time for Wu Fan. Although Wu Fan is still young, his understanding is extremely high. I discussed with the teacher a few days ago that the school will start in a few days. It will be just right to send him to the school to study, so as to make some preparations for the next time the Yuhu Sect comes to recruit disciples."
Upon hearing this, Mrs. Wu Fan nodded and agreed.
"Thank you to the village chief."
"Where there is, it should be, it should be. If that's the case, I'll bother you again when the time comes. Then I'll leave first."
After saying this, the village chief walked out of the door.
"Wait a minute, this is a small token of thanks for your help over the years. Please don't dislike it, the village chief."
As Wufaniang said, a pill appeared in her hand, "This is a muscle-strengthening pill. Although it is not very expensive, it can also strengthen muscles and bones and enhance a person's physique."
When the village chief heard this, his body couldn't help trembling. He caught the elixir with both hands, held it in his hands, and bowed quickly, "Thank you, thank you girl."
Mother Wufan just smiled slightly, said nothing, then turned around and entered the house. The village chief looked happy and hurried home with the elixir in his hands.
There was a trace of complicated emotions in Mother Wu Fan's eyes. She leaned against the window lattice and looked at the sky in a daze. She suddenly lowered her head and opened the purple sachet around her waist.
The sachet was about the size of half an adult's fist. It was sewn with complicated patterns, and the opening was tightly sewn. I didn't know what kind of spices were inside, but it always exuded a faint fragrance.
But when you smell it carefully, you can't feel it, it seems to be there but not at all.
sheLooking at the sachet, I couldn't help but murmur to myself, "I can't hide it no matter where I go. It turns out you really care about me." With a sigh, a drop of jade beads fell to the ground, shattering into thousands of past memories and turning into smoke.
In a blink of an eye, it was the day when school started, and Wu Fan was rubbing his little hands enthusiastically early in the morning.
After all, I have been listening to the voices in the school, but I have been unable to contact them due to my age. I can finally enter the school today, and my face is red with excitement.
